Puppet Studio 0 / 120 Frames FPS
100%
Pose: rotate bones; drag green IK rings to move limbs · move the root/hip to shift the character · child joints follow parent rotations · Space: play · Cmd/Ctrl+C/V: copy/paste keyframes
Camera & framing

Alt + drag on stage to pan camera; Alt + mouse wheel to zoom camera around the pointer. Camera changes are included in exports. Camera framing affects playback and exports. Add camera keyframes at different frames to animate pans and zooms.
